content_data.meeting_title: Fintech Cost Optimization Initiative - Steering Committee Update
agenda_items: Evaluation of proposed automation initiatives for back-office operations
Roadmap alignment for next phase of cost reduction efforts
Update on vendor contract renegotiation progress for key SaaS providers
Discussion on strategic implications of Q3 financial performance trends
Review of current cost baseline and identified savings opportunities to date
key_decisions: Approved allocation of resources for a pilot automation project in the claims processing department.
Formed a cross-functional task force to evaluate potential consolidation of payment gateway providers.
Prioritized renegotiation of cloud infrastructure contracts with a target of 15% reduction over the next 12 months.
